cause: Shared aliases select one mutable record for two IAM roles with efficiency caps 0.4 and 0.45. update_electricity_efficiency builds an unordered technology intersection and skips later adjustment after the first role. An aggregate electricity portfolio also falls back to kWh input energy and is treated as a generator.
required_resolution: Separate role-specific physical generator copies and audit aggregate portfolios before efficiency updates, preserving shared transformation logic. Verify different hash seeds without requiring a fixed seed in the public workflow.
scope_note: Fixed-seed comparison isolates the independent capture-metadata fix; it does not resolve or certify this role overlap.
